LanguageData.MM_StalkerAutoCombatDesc: Pursue visible, reachable enemies, seek cover and try to stay 24 to 30 cells away. Manual orders, hauling and caravan duties take priority. Disable to resume normal work.
LanguageData.MM_StalkerAutoBlinkDesc: Use blink while walking to shorten the route. Maximum distance: 20.9 cells; cooldown: 8 seconds. The destination must be visible, standable and unoccupied. The current task continues afterward. Manual blink remains available when disabled.
